as_told.title: Wilbert Smith top secret memo: flying saucers classified two points higher than the H-bomb

plain: A UFO researcher, Steven Greer, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a 1950 document from the Canadian government. Greer says it records what a Canadian named Wilbert Smith said, that it was top secret, and that it seems to have been declassified by accident. He says he put it in his own briefing document, because it would show a government was discussing UFOs in secret as early as 1950.
